project: Automated Web Application Security Assessment for Financial Platforms
scan_mode: passive discovery and low-impact checks; GET requests only; no form submissions

findings.title: Missing Content-Security-Policy response header
findings.evidence: The response did not include the Content-Security-Policy header.
findings.recommendation: Review whether Content-Security-Policy is appropriate for this application. Helps restrict which resources a browser may load.

findings.title: Missing Referrer-Policy response header
findings.evidence: The response did not include the Referrer-Policy header.
findings.recommendation: Review whether Referrer-Policy is appropriate for this application. Controls how much referrer information browsers send.

summary.note: Findings are indicators requiring validation, not proof of exploitable vulnerabilities.
